resolution.note: Deploy workflows on the base branch are detected by adopt --verify and refuse krn pr ship (exit 82) until krn.json deploy: acknowledged.

title: Adoption detects deploy workflows on the base branch and requires an acknowledged deploy before auto-merge
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114c missing item: auto-merge in an operator repository that deploys on push to main ships to production unattended.
Outcome: krn adopt and krn adopt --verify detect workflows triggered by pushes to the base branch that deploy; krn.json needs deploy: acknowledged before krn pr ship enables auto-merge there.
Proof: fixture tests with a deploying and a non-deploying workflow; npm run fast PASS.
